conventions.log_size: MMR node count (the profile's tree-size), a complete MMR size
conventions.commitment: accumulator node values concatenated, tallest first
conventions.signing: COSE_Sign1, alg -19 (Ed25519), kid = raw public key, CWT_Claims {iss, sub}; seed 0x07 x 32

negative.description: commitment carried as the -01 CBOR array [*bstr] instead of the concatenation.
log_size carries the leaf count (7). 7 is a complete size with 1 peak, so the 3-peak commitment no longer fits.
log_size 9 is not a complete MMR size.
leaf_count carries the node count instead of the leaf count.
prev_size > 0 and the log grew, but no consistency_proof.
consistency_proof as the pre-02 implementation map (size_a/size_b/old_peaks/witness/new_peaks), not the profile's consistency-proof.
first node of the first consistency path altered.

11 -> 39: all three origin peaks lead to the same height-4 peak; the second path's last node is altered. Only the check that every path to one peak agrees catches this: the first path alone still reaches the commitment.
a first checkpoint (prev_size 0) carrying a consistency_proof.
log_size == prev_size but the commitment differs from prev_commitment.
commitment altered: the honest proof from prev_commitment no longer reaches it.
internally valid (a correct proof 4 -> 39), but the Transparency Service last registered size 11 for this log identity; prev_* must equal that.

honest cp2 claims, but sub = '<log>#11' (the pre-02 implementations' form). The Transparency Service holds state for '<log>' only, so it sees a new log identity: continuity is never checked. Expected outcome 'first-seen', where the same claims under the log's own sub give 'continuous'.
